package.title: Open source
package.subtitle: Package published on pub.dev
package.tagline: Motion that knows when to stop.
package.description:
Flutter already knows when someone turns on “Reduce Motion” or “Remove Animations”. It stores that choice, and stops there.

AnimationController ignores “Reduce Motion” on purpose. The framework’s idea is to swap the slide for a fade, but that decision is left to each widget. In practice, almost nobody does it, so the card still slides in from the bottom for people who asked for motion to stop.

I published still to solve this in one place. A MotionScope around your app decides: slide, fade, or cut. StillSwitcher, StillEntrance, StillStagger, and StillPageRoute follow that decision. Wherever you don’t use one of these widgets, nothing moves.

The package doesn’t import Material, so the same code works in a custom design system and will keep working when Material leaves the SDK.

wrap.label: Wrap the app
wrap.lead: In main.dart, MotionScope is the parent of MaterialApp.
wrap.note: WidgetsApp takes the same parent. The package never imports Material, so a custom design system can use it as-is.

preference.label: Preference
preference.lead: Leave preference alone and the phone decides. Pass one when you want to preview a mode on your machine.

summary.title: About
summary.content:
I'm a Mobile Flutter Engineer with extensive experience leading the technical vision and architecture of high-performance, secure, and scalable mobile applications. Throughout my career, I have successfully driven strategic initiatives, including LGPD compliance projects, complex integrations, and the development of user-centric apps and websites across diverse industries.

My expertise spans Flutter, Clean Architecture, web technologies (Vue.js, Nuxt.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript), and UI/UX design with Figma. I am passionate about delivering clean, intuitive interfaces and seamless user experiences, always collaborating closely with product, UX, and backend teams.

Committed to continuous learning and team growth, I mentor developers, enforce coding standards, and promote best practices to build innovative and reliable solutions that exceed user expectations.
